text: Item edit dialog stamps ALL fields with fresh clocks — reverts collaborators concurrent edits (web + Android)

Groomed 2026-07-16: bumped p3 -> p2. This silently loses collaborator edits in
the flagship shared-list flow — worst user-facing correctness bug currently
open. T-91 now depends on this (same file, ItemDialog.tsx); land this first.

Implementation plan:

Web (ItemDialog owns the diff — pages stay dumb):
1. In ItemDialog, keep the snapshot the form was seeded from: `editingItem`'s
   values in edit mode, the picked suggestion's values after pickSuggestion
   (already in `matchedExisting`), all-empty in plain add mode.
2. In performSave, build `ItemDialogSaveValues` as today, but ALSO compute
   `changedFields: Set<keyof ItemFields>` by comparing each normalized value
   against the snapshot (stores: array equality; price: amount+currency pair;
   treat "" and null as equal for the optional strings).
3. Pass changedFields through onSave; ListPage/RegistryPage.handleSave spread
   only fieldPatch(...) entries whose key is in changedFields. New-item create
   (no snapshot id) keeps pushing all non-empty fields — a brand-new row has
   nothing to stomp. Status in edit mode: include only if changed.
4. Edge: save with zero changed fields -> skip the push entirely (no-op).

Android (ItemFormViewModel):
1. In startEdit/pickSuggestion, retain the loaded values (e.g. a private
   `loaded: ItemFormUiState?` or a small Snapshot data class).
2. In performSave's edit path, guard each repo call: rename only if
   trimmedName != loaded.name; setStatus only if status changed; same for
   category/stores/quantity/price/note (compare normalized values, e.g.
   price after parsePriceAmount).
3. The create path (`state.itemId == null`) is unchanged — createItem +
   setters are all first writes on a fresh row.
4. ItemsRepo needs no changes; the setters already stamp per-field.

Tests: web — edit only note, assert push contains ONLY note (and Android
mirror: repo fakes record which setters ran); adopt-a-suggestion-unmodified
pushes only status; zero-change save pushes nothing.
